title: I was working when the internet stopped
goalRo: La final vei putea să povestești o problemă sau o întâmplare, spunând ce se petrecea în momentul în care s-a întâmplat ceva.

vocab.ro: a se bloca, a „crăpa” (despre un program)
vocab.ex: The app crashed when I clicked the button.
vocab.exRo: Aplicația s-a blocat când am apăsat butonul.

vocab.ex: There was a power cut, and I lost my work.
vocab.exRo: A fost o pană de curent și mi-am pierdut munca.

vocab.ro: a îngheța, a se bloca (trecut: froze)
vocab.ex: My screen froze during the video call.
vocab.exRo: Mi s-a blocat ecranul în timpul apelului video.

vocab.ex: I was reading when suddenly the lights went off.
vocab.exRo: Citeam când deodată s-a stins lumina.

vocab.ex: While I was cooking, my friend called.
vocab.exRo: În timp ce găteam, m-a sunat un prieten.

vocab.ex: I saw a strange error message on the screen.
vocab.exRo: Am văzut un mesaj de eroare ciudat pe ecran.

vocab.ro: a face o copie de siguranță (backup)
vocab.ex: Luckily, I backed up all my files yesterday.
vocab.exRo: Din fericire, mi-am făcut ieri backup la toate fișierele.

vocab.ex: I restarted the laptop, and it worked again.
vocab.exRo: Am repornit laptopul și a mers din nou.

vocab.ex: The internet connection in the hotel was very slow.
vocab.exRo: Conexiunea la internet din hotel era foarte lentă.

vocab.ex: The server stopped while we were testing the app.
vocab.exRo: Serverul s-a oprit în timp ce testam aplicația.

vocab.ex: There was a big storm last night.
vocab.exRo: Azi-noapte a fost o furtună mare.

vocab.ex: He had an accident while he was riding his bike.
vocab.exRo: A avut un accident în timp ce mergea cu bicicleta.

vocab.ro: a se strica, a se defecta (trecut: broke down)
vocab.ex: Our car broke down on the way to the airport.
vocab.exRo: Ni s-a stricat mașina în drum spre aeroport.

vocab.ex: I spilled coffee on my keyboard!
The phone rang while I was having a shower.
vocab.exRo: Telefonul a sunat în timp ce făceam duș.

vocab.ex: She fell while she was running for the bus.
vocab.exRo: Ea a căzut în timp ce alerga după autobuz.

vocab.ex: My laptop fell, but luckily it still works.
vocab.exRo: Mi-a căzut laptopul, dar din fericire încă merge.

grammar.title: Past continuous and past simple: when and while
grammar.titleRo: Trecutul continuu și trecutul simplu: when și while

sections.textRo: Se formează cu **was / were + verb-ing**. Arată o acțiune **în desfășurare** la un moment din trecut: At ten o'clock I was working. În română folosim de obicei **imperfectul**: „lucram”, „dormeam”, „vorbeau”. Ai deja tot ce-ți trebuie: was/were de la A1 și forma -ing de la prezentul continuu!

examples.en: At 9 p.m. I was watching a film.
examples.ro: La ora 21 mă uitam la un film.

examples.en: We weren't working at that time.
What were you doing at ten?

sections.headingRo: When și while: o acțiune o întrerupe pe alta
sections.textRo: Acțiunea **lungă** (fundalul) → **past continuous**. Acțiunea **scurtă**, care o întrerupe → **past simple**. De obicei: **when** + past simple, **while** + past continuous. Exact ca în română: „Lucram (imperfect) când s-a oprit (perfect compus) curentul.”

examples.en: I was coding when the power went off.
While I was coding, the power went off.
examples.ro: În timp ce programam, s-a luat curentul.

examples.en: The phone rang when we were having dinner.
examples.ro: Telefonul a sunat când luam cina.

sections.textRo: Când două acțiuni lungi se petreceau **în același timp**, folosim past continuous pentru amândouă, de obicei cu **while**. E fundalul perfect pentru o poveste!

examples.en: While I was testing the app, my colleague was fixing the design.
examples.ro: În timp ce eu testam aplicația, colegul meu repara designul.

examples.en: It was raining, and we were walking to the hotel.
examples.ro: Ploua și noi mergeam spre hotel.

tipsRo: Nu folosi past continuous pentru acțiunea scurtă: nu „I was cooking when the phone was ringing”, ci **I was cooking when the phone rang**.
Nu uita **was / were**: **I was working**, nu „I working”.
Cu verbe ca **know, like, want** nu folosim de obicei forma -ing: **I knew the answer**, nu „I was knowing”.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.en: Andrei, what happened yesterday? You disappeared from the video call!
lines.ro: Andrei, ce s-a întâmplat ieri? Ai dispărut din apelul video!

lines.speaker: Andrei
lines.en: I'm so sorry. I was showing you the new features when the power went off.
lines.ro: Îmi pare foarte rău. Îți arătam noile funcții când s-a luat curentul.

lines.speaker: Andrei
lines.en: Yes. There was a big storm, and a tree fell on the electric cables in my street.
lines.ro: Da. Era o furtună mare și un copac a căzut peste cablurile electrice de pe strada mea.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.en: Oh no! Were you working on our project at the time?
lines.ro: Vai, nu! Lucrai la proiectul nostru în momentul acela?

lines.speaker: Andrei
lines.en: Yes, I was. Luckily, I backed up everything before the call.
lines.ro: Da. Din fericire, făcusem backup la tot înainte de apel.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.en: That's good. What were you doing when the power came back?
lines.ro: Bine. Ce făceai când a revenit curentul?

lines.speaker: Andrei
lines.en: I was sitting in the dark with a candle! Then I restarted the laptop and sent you an email.
lines.ro: Stăteam pe întuneric cu o lumânare! Apoi am repornit laptopul și ți-am trimis un e-mail.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.en: Yes, I got it. Let's try the demo again tomorrow.
lines.ro: Da, l-am primit. Hai să încercăm din nou demo-ul mâine.

reading.title: What a day!
reading.text:
Last summer, Ana was on holiday in Italy with her husband. One morning, they were driving to Rome when their car broke down on the motorway. It was very hot, and they didn't have much water.

While her husband was calling for help, Ana was looking for a café on her phone. Suddenly, her phone died – the battery was empty!

They waited for two hours. Finally, a mechanic arrived. While he was fixing the car, it started to rain. Ana laughed: 'What a day!'

They got to the hotel late in the evening. While they were checking in, the receptionist told them about a small restaurant near the hotel. They had a fantastic dinner there. 'In the end, it was a great day,' says Ana.
reading.textRo:
Vara trecută, Ana era în vacanță în Italia cu soțul ei. Într-o dimineață, mergeau cu mașina spre Roma când li s-a stricat mașina pe autostradă. Era foarte cald și nu aveau multă apă.

În timp ce soțul ei suna după ajutor, Ana căuta o cafenea pe telefon. Deodată, telefonul i s-a închis – bateria era descărcată!

Au așteptat două ore. În sfârșit, a venit un mecanic. În timp ce el repara mașina, a început să plouă. Ana a râs: „Ce zi!”

Au ajuns la hotel târziu seara. În timp ce se cazau, recepționerul le-a povestit despre un restaurant mic de lângă hotel. Au luat acolo o cină fantastică. „Până la urmă, a fost o zi grozavă”, spune Ana.

questions.q: What happened while they were driving to Rome?
questions.explainRo: „They were driving to Rome when their car broke down.”

questions.q: What was Ana doing when her phone died?
options: She was looking for a café.
questions.explainRo: „Ana was looking for a café on her phone. Suddenly, her phone died.”

questions.q: What happened while the mechanic was fixing the car?
questions.explainRo: „While he was fixing the car, it started to rain.”

exercises.q: What were you doing at 9 p.m.? – I ___ TV.
exercises.explainRo: Acțiune în desfășurare la un moment din trecut: I was watching.

exercises.q: They ___ dinner when the lights went out.
exercises.explainRo: Acțiunea lungă, cu they: were having.

exercises.q: I was coding when my laptop suddenly ___.
exercises.explainRo: Acțiunea scurtă, care o întrerupe pe cea lungă, e la past simple: crashed.

exercises.q: ___ I was waiting for the bus, I met an old friend.
exercises.explainRo: While + past continuous = în timp ce.

exercises.q: What ___ you doing when I called you?
exercises.explainRo: Cu you folosim were: What were you doing?

exercises.q: She wasn't ___ when the boss came in.
There was no electricity for three hours. It was a ___.
I ___ coffee on my keyboard! Now it doesn't work.

answers: was sleeping
were talking

exercises.q: He was walking to the office when he ___ (fall) on the ice.
answers: fell
exercises.explainRo: Acțiunea scurtă e la past simple; fall este neregulat: fall → fell.

exercises.q: The screen froze ___ I was writing an email.
answers: while
when
exercises.explainRo: While (sau when) introduce acțiunea lungă la past continuous.

exercises.audio: I was working when the internet stopped.
answers: I was working when the internet stopped.

exercises.audio: What were you doing at ten?
answers: What were you doing at ten?
What were you doing at 10?
exercises.explainRo: Întrebare la past continuous: What were you doing?

exercises.ro: Conduceam când mi s-a stricat mașina.
În timp ce gătea, a sunat telefonul.
exercises.explainRo: While + past continuous, apoi acțiunea scurtă la past simple.
Negativ la past continuous: weren't + verb-ing.

answers: I was working when the power went off.
I was working when the electricity went off.
I was working when the power went out.
I was working when the electricity went out.
I was working when the power stopped.
I was working when the electricity stopped.
I was working when there was a power cut.
exercises.explainRo: „Lucram” = I was working (acțiunea lungă); „s-a oprit” = past simple.

exercises.ro: Ce făceai ieri la ora opt?
answers: What were you doing yesterday at eight?
What were you doing at eight yesterday?
What were you doing yesterday at 8?
What were you doing at 8 yesterday?
What were you doing yesterday at eight o'clock?
What were you doing at eight o'clock yesterday?
exercises.explainRo: „Ce făceai” = What were you doing – past continuous.
